topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Unearthing the old oak, the spade hit something solid, unyielding. Dusting off the dirt, there it was—a metal box, the edges worn, the surface pitted with age. I couldn’t place it, no matter how hard I tried to sift through the layers of time. It didn’t belong to my hands, nor did it sit right in my memory. The locks were rusted, the hinges stuck, but it opened with a reluctant creak. Inside, a world of remnants from a life I didn’t recognize: yellowed letters, a vintage camera with a broken lens, coins from years long past. Each item a riddle, each piece a whisper from someone else’s yesterday.
